name: Halle
source:
“Most regrettable, but I am under no obligation to explain anything…
I must beg your understanding.”

Unit: Offense Black, 4th Squad
Rank: Address

A gifted woman whose temperament is among the most unusual of current H.A.Z.E. officers.

Because her ability allows her to operate entirely on her own in combat, she has never needed subordinates and has always served under others.

Her excessively deferential manner of speaking, combined with a deep, childlike curiosity, makes her behavior inconsistent and strangely immature.

Class: ???
Reality-Altering Ability: Best Practice — an ability that draws heat from the surroundings and manifests ice. Highly adaptable, it shows exceptional effectiveness in battles against large numbers of opponents.
